interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or different paving materials across the garage entrance to alert both drivers and pedestrians to the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Safety Mirrors
interventions.description: Install convex mirrors at the garage exit to improve sightlines for drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Audible/Visual Exit Warnings
interventions.description: Install sensors that trigger flashing lights or a sound when a vehicle is exiting the garage to warn pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Reconstruct the walkway on the left with a smooth, ADA-compliant surface and a clear curb to separate it from the parking area.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Install a permanent, protected sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to provide safe crossing points across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Prune overgrown vegetation and remove debris to restore the full width and accessibility of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Dedicated Bicycle Infrastructure
interventions.description: Implement a marked or protected bike lane to provide safe separation for cyclists, especially during construction phases.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces, improving safety for all road users.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crossing with signage to allow pedestrians to safely transition to the open sidewalk.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding a planting strip would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Improve Construction Site Sightlines
interventions.description: Relocate large equipment or use transparent fencing to ensure pedestrians remain visible to drivers near the site.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear overgrown vegetation to restore the full width of the existing sidewalk.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a new sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Safety Signage
interventions.description: Deploy signage to alert drivers of potential pedestrians and guide walkers to safe detours.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Establish a clearly defined and protected temporary walkway using barriers to separate pedestrians from construction and traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a permanent, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Infill Development or Screening
interventions.description: Encourage active ground-floor uses or provide high-quality landscape screening for the surface parking lot to reduce the impact of blank frontages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Expand the walkway to a minimum of 6 feet of clear width and ensure a continuous, level surface.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove the construction barrel and ensure the walkway remains clear of debris and equipment.

interventions.title: Install sidewalk on left side
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or thin the trees and shrubs on the inside of the curve to improve sightlines for all road users.
